title: Register of Advance Liability Notice Forms: Blood Glucose Testing Supply Program
content:
Each tier of the Blood Glucose Testing Supply Program has one form of advance notice of financial liability: the notice a customer must sign before an item or quantity expected to be denied can be billed to them.

| Tier | Notice form of the tier |
|---|---|
| Testing Supplies Self-Pay Program | Not applicable |
| Testing Supplies Commercial HMO Program | Plan member waiver |
| Testing Supplies Commercial PPO Program | Plan member waiver |
| Testing Supplies Medicare Advantage Program | Organization determination required |
| Testing Supplies Original Medicare Program | CMS Advance Beneficiary Notice of Noncoverage (form CMS-R-131) |
| Testing Supplies Medicaid Program | Medicaid non-covered services agreement |

**Reading the register**

- The form follows the tier, so two programs on the same tier always use the same form, and a program that changes tier takes the form of its new tier.
- The register names five values in all: not applicable, plan member waiver, organization determination required, the CMS Advance Beneficiary Notice, and the Medicaid non-covered services agreement. The two commercial tiers share one form.
- Which form is used tells nothing about whether a particular item will be paid; it only names the paper that applies on the tier.
